items.en: Qatar Says US-Iran Deal Drafts Are Circulating as Trump Eyes Reopening the Strait of Hormuz
items.zh: 卡達：美伊協議草案已在傳閱，川普看好荷姆茲海峽可望重新開通
items.summary: Qatar's Foreign Ministry said efforts to resolve the US-Iran conflict are in 'very progressive stages' and that drafts of a potential agreement are being circulated. President Trump said the Strait of Hormuz could fully reopen soon, while Iran was reported to be seeking control of a new shipping route through the waterway. Fresh attacks near the strait pushed oil higher on Tuesday, but equities largely shrugged off the news, treating it as an energy story rather than a growth-and-inflation risk. Talks remain fragile, with Tehran publicly disputing how far negotiations have advanced.

items.en: US Military Has Burned Through Nearly 80% of a Key Missile Interceptor as Commanders Warn Stockpiles Are 'Dangerously Low'
items.zh: 美軍關鍵攔截飛彈已消耗近八成，指揮官示警庫存「危險偏低」
items.summary: Senior US commanders warn the Pentagon's munitions stockpile is 'dangerously low' after the war with Iran. Roughly four-fifths of the THAAD interceptor inventory and about half of Patriot interceptors have been expended. CSIS estimates Patriot stocks have fallen to fewer than 827 from 2,300 pre-war, and THAAD to under 278 from 452, leaving little margin for Europe or the Indo-Pacific. Rebuilding THAAD inventories could take three or more years. The Pentagon has requested $18.2 billion to replenish interceptors as part of a $67 billion emergency spending package.

items.en: Michigan Democrats Vote in a Senate Primary Seen as a Test of the Party's Progressive Wing
items.zh: 密西根民主黨參議員初選開票，被視為進步派動能的試金石
items.summary: Michigan held the marquee contest of a five-state primary day, with Rep. Haley Stevens facing former public health official Dr. Abdul El-Sayed for the Democratic Senate nomination left open by retiring Sen. Gary Peters. The race is widely read as a test of momentum for the party's progressive wing ahead of the November 3 general election. Missouri, Kansas, Virginia and Washington also voted. A crowded Democratic gubernatorial primary featuring Secretary of State Jocelyn Benson was on the same ballot.

items.en: S&P 500 Returns to a Record and the Dow Tops 54,000 as the Tech Comeback Broadens
items.zh: 標普 500 重返歷史新高、道瓊站上 54,000 點，科技股反攻擴散
items.summary: US stocks closed sharply higher on Tuesday. The S&P 500 rose 1.79% to 7,737 for a record close, the Dow climbed 1.71% to 54,086 after adding 907 points, and the Nasdaq Composite jumped 2.59% to 26,585. Technology shares gained 4.20% and industrials 3.42%. Roughly 85% of S&P 500 companies have beaten estimates this season with aggregate profit growth tracking above 47%, giving investors a bottom-up reason to stay invested even as Middle East headlines kept oil volatile.

items.en: Prosecutors Drop More Lincoln Memorial Vandalism Charges After Contractor Is Blamed
items.zh: 承包商才是禍首，檢方再撤銷林肯紀念堂倒影池「破壞」指控
items.summary: US Attorney Jeanine Pirro dropped charges against three more people accused of vandalizing the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool, after a court filing revealed the pool's problems were caused by the contractor rather than by vandalism. The reversal follows earlier dismissals in the same case and has renewed criticism of how quickly charges were brought. The episode has become a talking point about prosecutorial vetting in high-profile Washington cases.

items.en: Claude Opus 5 Holds the Top Spot as Anthropic, OpenAI and Google Reshuffle Their Model Lineups
items.zh: Claude Opus 5 穩居第一，Anthropic、OpenAI、Google 模型陣容重新洗牌
items.summary: Claude Opus 5, released July 24, 2026, remains Anthropic's flagship and the current number-one model on Artificial Analysis, while Claude Sonnet 5 became the default model on June 30. OpenAI previewed GPT-5.6 on June 26 behind a US-government access list. Google's Gemini 3.5 Pro is still unreleased, with Bloomberg reporting on July 16 that it is months behind schedule and short of internal goals, particularly on coding. Claude Code shipped a VSCode Focus view plus stronger sandbox credential masking and permission handling.

items.en: Samsung, SK Hynix and Micron Have Sold Out Their Entire 2027 DRAM and HBM Output
items.zh: 三星、SK 海力士、美光 2027 全年 DRAM 與 HBM 產能已全數售罄
items.summary: The three big memory makers wrapped up 2027 capacity allocation months ahead of schedule, with their entire 2027 DRAM and HBM output reportedly booked. NAND capacity through August 2026 is nearing full booking, and most buyers are said to be receiving only 60% to 70% of what they requested. DRAM spot prices have surged nearly 700% over the past year. IDC expects 2026 DRAM supply growth of only 16% and NAND 17%, both far below the 20-30% historical norm, keeping the shortage structural rather than cyclical.

items.en: Palantir Revenue Jumps 93% and US Commercial Sales Soar 149% in a Blowout Quarter
items.zh: Palantir 營收年增 93%、美國商用業務暴衝 149%，財報全面超標
items.summary: Palantir reported Q2 revenue of $1.94 billion, up 93% year over year, with adjusted EPS of 41 cents and US commercial revenue up 149%. Management raised full-year guidance and now projects at least 134% growth in US commercial revenue, citing accelerating demand for sovereign AI deployments. Citi and Deutsche Bank lifted price targets, arguing AI spending is rotating from infrastructure toward software. The stock closed up more than 26%, its largest single-day move of the year.

items.en: MLB Trade Deadline Closes With the Red Sox Landing Adley Rutschman and the Dodgers Adding Tarik Skubal
items.zh: MLB 交易大限落幕：紅襪搶下捕手 Rutschman，道奇補進王牌 Skubal
items.summary: The 2026 MLB trade deadline passed at 5 p.m. Central on August 4. The Boston Red Sox made the biggest deadline-day splash by acquiring catcher Adley Rutschman from the Baltimore Orioles. The headline blockbuster had landed days earlier when Tarik Skubal joined the Los Angeles Dodgers, giving them what analysts call the game's most feared rotation. The New York Yankees added infielder Luis Garcia Jr. from Washington for four right-handed pitchers. Philadelphia was also among the aggressive buyers.

items.en: Leagues Cup 2026 League Phase Kicks Off With 36 MLS and Liga MX Clubs
items.zh: 2026 美墨聯賽盃開打，36 隊爭 8 張淘汰賽門票
items.summary: The 2026 Leagues Cup league phase began on August 4 with 36 MLS and Liga MX clubs competing for the eight knockout-stage places. Opening-night fixtures included Columbus Crew against Atlas, FC Cincinnati against Pachuca, Charlotte FC against Pumas UNAM, Minnesota United against Juarez, Tigres UANL against Real Salt Lake, and Vancouver Whitecaps against Atlante. The revamped format spreads matches across a compressed August window before the knockout rounds.

items.en: Premier League Summer Window Still Has Three Weeks to Run Before the August 31 Deadline
items.zh: 英超夏季轉會窗還剩三週，8/31 關門前仍有變數
items.summary: The Premier League summer transfer window opened on 15 June 2026 and does not close until 31 August, leaving roughly four weeks of business as the 2026-27 season approaches. Clubs typically accelerate spending in the final fortnight, so August is when the largest fees are usually agreed. Squad registration rules and profit-and-sustainability limits continue to shape how aggressively clubs can move late in the window.

items.en: New Framework Study Pushes Six-Module Model for University Mental Health Systems
items.zh: 新研究提出大學心理健康支持系統的「六模組」架構
items.summary: Research published in Frontiers in Psychology argues that college students face rising mental health pressure from academic load, career uncertainty and social adaptation. The proposed system spans six modules: building educators' mental health capacity, dynamic monitoring of student psychological states, developing grassroots psychological service teams, tiered crisis intervention, co-constructing supportive classroom environments, and targeted support for special student groups. Resource allocation is identified as a mediating and moderating factor in how well such systems actually work.

items.en: Machine Learning Study Maps Burnout Risk Profiles Among Psychology Students
items.zh: 機器學習研究：心理系學生的「倦怠風險輪廓」可被提前辨識
items.summary: An exploratory study used machine learning to cluster psychology students into distinct burnout risk profiles rather than treating burnout as a single continuum. Profiles differ in exhaustion, cynicism and reduced efficacy, and map onto different combinations of workload perception, self-efficacy and social support. The authors argue profile-based screening lets universities target interventions at the students most at risk instead of applying one generic wellbeing programme, and that early-semester screening is more actionable than end-of-term surveys.

items.en: The 'Big Three' Health Behaviours Track Closely With Student Psychological Wellbeing
items.zh: 睡眠、飲食、運動「三大健康行為」與學生心理健康高度相關
items.summary: Reviews of student mental health data continue to find that practising one or more of the 'Big Three' health behaviours - sleep, diet and exercise - is associated with better mental health and psychological wellbeing. The same literature highlights the weight of interpersonal relationships and self-protection factors. Context remains sobering: CDC data showed 40% of US high school students reporting persistent sadness or hopelessness, about a third reporting poor mental health, and 20% seriously considering suicide.

items.en: Palantir's Blowout Quarter Signals AI Spending Is Rotating From Chips Toward Software
items.zh: Palantir 財報大爆發，象徵 AI 支出正從晶片轉向軟體層
items.summary: Palantir's 93% revenue growth and 149% jump in US commercial sales prompted Citi and Deutsche Bank to raise targets on the view that AI budgets are shifting from infrastructure to application software. On the same day AWS revenue grew 37% and analysts pushed Amazon targets as high as $400. Taken together, the prints suggest the AI trade is broadening beyond GPU suppliers into the companies monetising deployment, which is also why Taiwanese software and cybersecurity proxies have started to attract rotation flows.

items.en: Intel's EMIB-T Packaging Reportedly Hits ~90% Yield at Half the Cost of CoWoS
items.zh: 英特爾 EMIB-T 封裝良率傳近九成、成本僅 CoWoS 一半，台積電承壓
items.summary: Reports that Intel's EMIB-T advanced packaging has reached roughly 90% yield at about half the cost of TSMC's CoWoS weighed on TSMC shares in Taipei. Foreign investors sold 12,430 lots of TSMC on August 4 after 9,717 lots on August 3, and the stock fell 2.11% to NT$2,320, dragging the TAIEX by an estimated 418 points on its own. TSMC is reported to be developing a competing packaging technology. Advanced packaging cost structure is emerging as the next battleground in AI accelerator supply.

items.en: Quantum Names Rally on a Nasdaq Deal and a Completed Chip-Fab Buyout
items.zh: 量子運算族群走強：D-Wave 拿下 Nasdaq 合作、IonQ 完成 SkyWater 併購
items.summary: D-Wave Quantum rose about 11% to $20.08 on a new collaboration with Nasdaq Verafin, while IonQ gained roughly 9% to $39.62 after closing its $1.8 billion acquisition of SkyWater Technology, giving it in-house fabrication. Rigetti Computing added about 9% to $16.23 and Quantum Computing Inc. about 8% to $8.74. The moves extend a pattern in which quantum equities trade on commercial partnerships and vertical integration rather than on technical milestones alone.

items.en: YOASOBI Announce a 10-City Asia Dome and Stadium Tour for 2026-2027 Including Taipei and Hong Kong
items.zh: ★ YOASOBI 宣布 2026–2027 亞洲十城巨蛋巡演，台北、香港都在名單內
items.summary: YOASOBI have announced the 'YOASOBI ASIA 10-CITY DOME & STADIUM TOUR 2026-2027', spanning five Japanese cities (Osaka, Nagoya, Fukuoka, Sapporo and Tokyo) plus Taipei, Seoul, Hong Kong, Singapore and one city still unannounced. The Hong Kong date is set for the Kai Tak Sports Park main venue, and the Taipei show is expected at the Taipei Dome. Exact dates and ticket on-sale times for the Taiwan and Hong Kong legs have not been fully disclosed, so lottery windows are worth monitoring now.

items.en: Vaundy's First Asia Arena Tour Locks In Hong Kong on Oct 3 and Taipei Arena on Oct 31 - Nov 1
items.zh: ★ Vaundy 首次亞洲巡演定案：10/3 香港亞洲博覽館、10/31–11/1 台北小巨蛋
items.summary: Vaundy will play his first Asia arena tour in 2026, opening in Chiba in September before travelling to Seoul, Hong Kong, Fukuoka, Taipei and Shanghai. The Hong Kong show is set for October 3 at AsiaWorld-Arena, and Taipei gets two nights at Taipei Arena on October 31 and November 1. He has also announced his largest-ever domestic arena tour for 2027-2028. The Taipei dates fall on a Saturday and Sunday, which makes them the easiest overseas leg to attend from Taiwan.

items.en: LiSA Confirms a New Full Album Plus a Domestic Arena Run and an Asia Tour
items.zh: ★ LiSA 宣布發行新專輯，並加開日本 Arena 巡演與亞洲巡迴
items.summary: LiSA has announced a new full-length album alongside a domestic arena tour and an Asia tour, her broadest touring plan in several years. Asia legs from Japanese arena acts of her scale have historically included Taipei and Hong Kong, so both are plausible stops once the full routing is published. Ticket ballots for Japanese arena runs typically open two to three months ahead of the first date, meaning registration windows for the earliest shows are likely already live.

items.en: Mrs. GREEN APPLE's Sixth Original Album Is Set for September 30
items.zh: ★ Mrs. GREEN APPLE 第 6 張正規專輯確定 9/30 發行
items.summary: Mrs. GREEN APPLE's sixth original full album is scheduled for release on September 30, 2026, with a special site already live on Universal Music Japan. The band released the digital single 'Kaze to Machi' on April 13 as the theme song for the NHK morning drama 'Kaze, Kaoru', which is expected to anchor the record. An accompanying arena run has been announced for the autumn-to-winter window. No overseas legs have been confirmed so far.

items.en: Ado Puts Seven Past Concerts on Streaming and Preps Her Nissan Stadium Shows
items.zh: ★ Ado 一口氣上架 7 場過往演唱會音源，日產球場「蒼」演出接續登場
items.summary: Ado began streaming full live audio from seven past concerts on July 31, covering her first live 'Kigeki', 'Campanella', the 2023 tour 'Mars', her first world tour 'Wish', the 2024 National Stadium show 'Shinzo', the 2024 Japan tour 'Mona Lisa no Yokogao', and her second world tour 'Hibana'. She is also staging 'Ado STADIUM LIVE 2026 Ao' at Nissan Stadium in Kanagawa across two nights for roughly 72,000 seats per show, Japan's largest venue.
